Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that "McFarland, USA" was released in 2015 based on a single search engine snippet (DuckDuckGo) without verifying the specific release date against the authoritative sources explicitly requested in the instructions (Wikipedia, Box Office Mojo, IMDb). While the Planner correctly identified the year 2015 from the snippet, it failed to extract the precise date (February 20, 2015) or confirm the country of release from the actual Wikipedia or Box Office Mojo pages as instructed. This led to an incomplete data set for comparison, as the Planner relied on unverified snippet data rather than the full content of the authoritative sources it was tasked to open. This error pattern matches the "Premature Resolution" and "Incomplete Extraction" signatures seen in the reference examples, where the agent assumes partial data from a search result is sufficient before accessing the primary source.
